name: A specialization switch restores a gated build, and Dreadnought spends only its level's points (#4463, #4466, #4821)
contract: A switch stores the build being left and restores the entered one rank by rank through the talent rules (StoreBuilds/RestoreBuilds); the stored picks are in entry order, so a restore must still satisfy the row gates. Venomancer (class 29) Venom specialization 54, tab VENOM: rows 0-3 hold Wilt 30477 (804982), Spore 30606 (804983), Protraction 7219 (706942), Fungal Growth 6137 (804987), Acid Bolt 6687 (706025), Rotting Away 9575 (706370), Mycosis 30479 (804986) and Envenom 6138 (805900); Captivation 5215 (503930) is row 4 with RequiredTabTEInvestment 8 and the lowest entry id of them all. Stalking is specialization 53. #4463 and #4466 report characters whose trees were empty or locked after a switch. Cultist (class 25) Dreadnought is specialization 96 (tab BULWARK): Twilight Shieldtoss 7404 (524876) is row 0 and Adaptive Combatant 7612 (300268) row 1, TalentEssenceCost 1 each; CharacterAdvancementEssence gives class 25 one specialization point at level 12 and two at 13. #4821 reports unlimited Dreadnought points. Expected: switching away and back restores Captivation with the eight points above it, and Dreadnought buys one talent at 12 and a second at 13.
